name: GLOWDOWN
title: Glowdown
blurb: Match suit or face, play your actions, shed every card first. House rules to switch on. Two to eight players.
description: An original shedding game with its own deck of light: Sun, Moon, Star and Bolt, ZAP +2, BLOCK, BOUNCE and PRISMs. Match the suit or the face and be first out. Switch on stacking, jump-in, 7 swaps and 0 rotates, or draw until you can play. Bots fill empty seats.
author: lokeshmohanty
